authored.title: لأن
authored.explanation_ar: نربط النتيجة بسببها؛ تأتي بعد because جملة تحتوي فاعلًا وفعلًا، ويمكن أن تأتي جملة السبب أولًا.
authored.explanation_en: Use because before a full clause containing a subject and verb to explain the reason for something.
authored.contrast_ar: I stayed home because it rained جملة سبب؛ I stayed home because of the rain اسم سبب.
authored.contrast_en: Because introduces a full reason clause; because of introduces a noun or gerund phrase.

authored.explanation_en: Use so to introduce the result of a situation. The clause before it usually gives the reason.
authored.contrast_ar: It rained, so we stayed home نتيجة؛ We stayed home because it rained سبب.
authored.contrast_en: So introduces a result after its cause; because introduces the reason for a result.

advanced.prompt: أي تفسير دقيق يميز هذا البناء عن الأنماط المرتبطة؟
options: So introduces the cause after the result in every sentence.
So requires a noun phrase without a verb after it.
So introduces the result after the cause in this construction.
advanced.answer: So introduces the result after the cause in this construction.
